title: Logging and Monitoring
description: Set up structured logging and alerts for security events.

data.text: You cannot protect what you cannot see. Structured logging and monitoring turn security events into actionable insights.
Serilog stores logs as structured data instead of plain text, making it easy to query and analyze.
Ship logs to a monitoring platform and set up alerts for spikes in 401, 403, or 429 responses.

data.title: Correlation IDs
data.text: Generate a correlation ID per request to trace attacks across services.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Ship logs to a centralized platform
data.takeaway: You now have a layered security strategy from CORS to monitoring.
